about.title: About the clinical bases
about.p1: The clinical bases of Saribekyan International Medical University combine patient care and teaching in one environment. Students work under specialist supervision on real clinical cases.
about.p2: The complex and the dental centre are equipped for diagnostics and treatment so that teaching meets current clinical standards.

about.p1: The simulation centre and dental rooms let students repeat clinical skills before they work with real patients.
